# Obsidian Nord

Obsidian Nord applies the arctic-inspired Nord palette to Obsidian's UI and editor at low contrast. Syntax highlighting and themed UI elements are kept consistent, which the recorded description frames as distraction-free note-taking across the interface.

![Obsidian Nord screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/insanum/obsidian_nord/HEAD/dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Obsidian Nord"
    author: "insanum"
    repo:   "insanum/obsidian_nord"
    slug:   "obsidian-nord"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/obsidian-nord"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/insanum/obsidian_nord"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/insanum/obsidian_nord/HEAD/dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Nord's arctic-inspired color palette to Obsidian for calm, low-contrast UI and editor styling. Use consistent syntax highlighting and themed UI elements for clear, distraction-free note-taking. Keep a cohesive visual experience across Obsidian's interface."
}
```
